1.text: Umukunzi wawe yagiye he,Yewe wa mugore we, w'indatwa mu bagore?Umukunzi wawe yerekeye he,Kugira ngo tumushakane nawe? Umugeni:

2.text: Umukunzi wanjye yamanutse ajya mu murima we,Mu turima tw'imibavu,Kuragira mu murima,No guca uburabyo bw'imyangange.

3.text: Ndi uw'umukunzi wanjye,Umukunzi wanjye na we ni uwanjye,Aragirira umukumbi we mu myangange. Umukwe:

4.text: Mukunzi wanjye, uri mwiza nka Tirusa,Urarimba nk'i Yerusalemu,Uteye ubwoba nk'igitero cy'ingabo zigendana ibendera.

5.text: Unkureho amaso yawe,Kuko binzonga.Umusatsi wawe umeze nk'umukumbi w'ihene,Ziryamye mu ibanga ry'i Galeyadi.

6.text: Amenyo yawe yera nk'umukumbi w'intama zivuye kuhagirwa,Zose zigenda zikurikirwa n'impanga zazo,Ntihagira n'imwe ipfusha.

7.text: Mu misaya yawe hameze nk'igisate cy'ikomamanga,Hagati y'imishunzi yawe.

8.text: Hariho abamikazi mirongo itandatu,N'inshoreke mirongo inani,N'abakobwa batabarika.

9.text: Ariko inuma yanjye naciye akayonga ni we gusa,Ni ikinege cya nyina,Ni umutoni w'uwamubyaye.Abakobwa iyo bamubonye bamwita Uwahiriwe,Ndetse abamikazi n'inshoreke na bo baramusingiza. Abakobwa:

10.text: Uyu ni nde utungutse umeze nk'umuseke utambitse?Ni mwiza nk'ukwezi,Arabagirana nk'ikizubazuba,Ateye ubwoba nk'igitero cy'ingabo zigendana ibendera. Umugeni:

11.text: Naramanutse njya mu murima w'imijozi,Kureba imbuto zashibutse mu kibaya,Kureba ko umuzabibu upfunditse udupfundo,N'imikomamanga ko irabije.

12.text: Ntarabimenya,Umutima wanjye wangejeje mu magare y'intambara,Y'ubwoko bwanjye bw'imfura. Abakobwa:
